newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish NTMA 80 mln punt auction covered 1.50 times.
newsitem.headline: Irish NTMA 80 mln punt auction covered 1.50 times.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) on Tuesday said an 80 million punt auction of the eight percent bond due 2006 was covered 1.50 times.
The NTMA said the highest accepted price was 110.25 and the highest annual yield was 6.48 percent.
The lowest accepted price and yield was 110.00 and 6.51 percent and the average price/yield was 110.08 and 6.50 percent, the NTMA said.
It said 10 percent of bids at the lowest price were filled.
The NTMA said a non-competitive auction for primary dealers of 16 million punts of the stock was sold at 110.08.
